entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie... I hope you can help me. I... I need to return an order. It's a helmet I bought a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. It's just... the color. It looked so different on the website. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I'm usually so happy, but this just isn't right. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.

I understand. Getting the color right is important, especially for gear you'll be wearing all the time. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. Let me just pull up your account. Can I get your order number?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I just... I feel awful about this, but I really needed that money for something else that came up. I was counting on being able to send it back if it didn't work out.
I completely understand, and thank you for that order number. Let's see here... Okay, I see the helmet was delivered 33 days ago.
Oh... is that too long? I was so busy, I didn't even get to it. Please tell me it's not too late.
No, not at all! According to our return policy, you're well within the 90-day window for a return. I can go ahead and process that for you right now.
You can? Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Charlie. I was so worried.

Of course. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. You'll receive a full refund within 3-5 business days after we receive it.
That is wonderful news. You've really helped me out today. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with for your VeloFit account?
No, that was everything. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
